title: Teachers’ Day 2026: State-Level Essay Competition Invites Maharashtra Teachers To Showcase Conscious Use Of AI In Education
text: Teachers’ Day 2026: State-Level Essay Competition Invites Maharashtra Teachers To Showcase Conscious Use Of AI In Education. The Shikshan Vikas Manch of Yashwantrao Chavan Centre has announced a state-level essay competition for teachers on conscious AI use in teaching and learning. Participants must share practical experiences using tools like ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude, including prompts, verification methods and outcomes. Active teachers from recognised schools can submit Marathi or English entries by Sep 20, 2026.
